name: Subsidy for Disabled Young Professionals
benefit:
1. Under this scheme, loans up to ₹25,00,000/- are provided to professionally educated unemployed disabled youth who fall under the OH, VH, HH, or MR categories.
   1. The loan is available at different interest rates ranging from 4.5% to 8% per annum.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should have a disability of at least 40%.
   1. The applicant&#39;s age should be between 18 and 45 years.
   1. The applicant should have obtained a professional degree from a recognized Institute.
   1. The scheme is for professionally educated unemployed disabled youth.
   1. The activity proposed should be directly relevant to the professional degree of the applicant.
